locations.name: Master's Study
locations.description: Incense hangs in the still air. Talismans cover the walls, and a brass lamp casts a steady circle of light over the master's desk.

result.message: Behind the talismans lies a practice record showing that the master's famous feats rely on preparation and misdirection.
Only a clean wick and ordinary lamp oil.

locations.name: Wood Shed
locations.description: The shed smells of pine resin and damp earth. Fresh shavings cover the floor, while a narrow beam of sunlight reaches the back wall.

result.message: A loose plank conceals silk thread, fine paper, and a small mirror, enough to reproduce several of the master's tricks.
The axe is worn from ordinary firewood work.

locations.name: Guest Room
locations.description: A low bed stands beneath a paper window. The room is tidy, but the traveler's bundle has been opened and hastily tied again.

result.message: The bundle contains a copied account of the mountain visit, including details that could only have been learned from a rehearsal.
The paper is thin and unmarked.

locations.name: Mountain Road
locations.description: Mist drifts across the stones. A line of footprints climbs toward the temple, interrupted where the path narrows beside the ravine.

result.message: The footprints begin with heavy boots and return with bare, careful steps, suggesting someone changed shoes before the demonstration.
Loose stones, but no hidden object.

locations.name: Moon Room
locations.description: A round room opens beneath the eaves. Moonlight falls through a skylight onto a shallow wine bowl and a sheet of white paper.

result.message: The glowing moon is ordinary paper the next morning; the effect depends on the master's focused intention and a concealed light source.
The bowl contains only clean water.

ambient_locations.name: Mountain Gate
ambient_locations.description: Mist parts around the gate, revealing the valley far below.

ambient_location_rule.message: Give atmosphere only and never invent evidence.
